mechanism_fidelity.rationale: The mapping retains explicit competing explanations, comparison of every feature against every sequence, emphasis on diagnostic contradictions, and sensitivity testing for doubtful datings. Its inference weakens contradicted sequences without proving survivors true, while retaining limits from omitted alternatives, evidence dependence and subjective interpretation.

target_fidelity.rationale: Weakening contradicted revision-and-assembly sequences and preserving alternatives and uncertain intervals directly contributes to determining the best-supported formation sequence and identifying uncertain claims. This is an explicitly bounded contribution.

operational_coherence.rationale: Comparing manuscript features against the specified sequences can reveal differential conflicts with corrections and physical joins. Those conflicts warrant weakening affected sequences, while sensitivity to uncertain datings bounds the resulting chronology.

validity.rationale: All three criteria pass: the candidate preserves comparative elimination through diagnostic inconsistency and applies it directly to formation sequences with explicit uncertainty.

uncertainty: The packet does not reproduce the three sequences, manuscript features or completed matrix, so it does not establish which sequence survives or which particular intervals remain uncertain.
